This requires a CI gate that treats each roster fact as a stochastic variable with uncertain ground truth. The "Duplicate Gate" prevents redundant processing, while "wrong_team_number_status_corruption" formalizes the high-stakes cost of errors. The "Canonical Truth Store" provides a deterministic foundation for probabilistic inference in GSI and state-based reasoning in GSE. Finally, "official_current_evidence_wins" acts as a principled tie-breaker in conflict resolution, ensuring consistency across heterogeneous data sources. Together, these primitives create a robust, mathematically unified framework for roster data quality.
